title: lowercase welcome coupon code (welcome10) is accepted and takes 10% off

report.text: Hi Kiln team, I'm Priya Sharma ([redacted-email], [redacted-phone]). I typed welcome10 into the coupon box at checkout but it just says "That coupon code is not valid". The code from your welcome email should work!

reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the message "That coupon code is not valid." is not shown"

verdict.title: Welcome discount code is rejected as invalid
verdict.oneLiner: The checkout rejects the expected 10% welcome coupon instead of applying its $2.80 discount.
verdict.rootCause: The checkout treats the welcome coupon as invalid, so it shows an error and leaves the discount at $0.00 rather than applying the promised 10% reduction.
verdict.suggestion: Check the configured welcome coupon and its validation rules, then ensure it displays the success message and changes the order summary discount to $2.80.

attempts.agentSummary:
I've fixed BUG-005 but haven't verified it: I couldn't get a Kane run or a manual check. `gremlin_verify_fix` and `gremlin_guard` were both refused for permission, and so was `curl` against localhost:4000. Gremlin's Stop hook will replay the flow with Kane when I finish, and that result is the real test.

**Root cause:** `cartTotals` in `server.js` looked up `coupons[couponCode]` using exactly what the customer typed. Coupon keys are stored in uppercase (`WELCOME10`), so `welcome10`, or a code with a stray space, didn't match and got "That coupon code is not valid."

**Fix:** `cartTotals` (`server.js:35-37`) now trims the code and uppercases it before looking it up, and only accepts codes that really exist in the `coupons` table. Both the Apply button (`/api/coupon`) and placing an order (`/api/orders`) go through this function, so both now accept the code in any case. With one mug in the cart ($28.00), `welcome10` should now apply a $2.80 discount.
